events.subject: Compensation Claim - Flight AI162 on 2026-09-09
events.body:
Dear Air India Customer Relations,

I am writing to claim compensation for flight AI162 on 2026-09-09 from London Heathrow Airport (LHR) to Delhi Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL), under booking reference [Booking Reference] / ticket number 0982100000000.

The flight was scheduled to arrive at 10 Sept, 00:20, but actually arrived at 10 Sept, 03:47. This represents a total delay at final destination of 3 hours and 27 minutes (207 minutes).

Under UK Regulation 261/2004, I am entitled to £520 in compensation for this delay. 

Please confirm receipt of this letter and arrange payment of £520 within 14 days of this notice to the following account details: [Bank Account Details].

If I do not receive a satisfactory response or full payment within 14 days, I will escalate this matter to the relevant aviation authority or an Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) scheme without further notice.

Yours sincerely,
Alex Demo
alex.demo@example.com
